contract: Each side opens the same preloaded seekable file, reads every packet, folds the stream index and its published additions, and tears the reader down.
Kind 4 subtypes are opaque BlockAdditional wire bytes (including the 8-byte big-endian ID), LCEVC NAL bytes and HDR10+ fields, in that order.
HDR10+ rows contain application version, window count, targeted display luminance, targeted and mastering grids, and each window in order.

A grid contributes presence, dimensions and row-major samples over 15. A window contributes geometry presence, corners over 1 and ellipse fields when present, MaxSCL and average over 100000, then count and ordered percentile pairs, and bright-pixel fraction over 1000.
Tone-curve presence precedes both knee coordinates over 4095 and counted anchors over 1023. Saturation presence precedes weight over 8. Rationals fold numerator and denominator in that order.
Triergon derives the side data from each typed packet and checks the HDR result against the direct T.35 entry point. A terminal row distinguishes EOF from an input refusal.

open_policies.policy: Triergon refuses a truncated HDR10+ BlockAdditional
open_policies.undecided: RFC 9559 section 5.1.3.5.2 with BlockAddIDType 4 (section 5.1.4.1.17): the BlockAdditional is an ITU-T T.35 HDR10+ message, here cut after 13 bytes, inside its syntax.
open_policies.rule: Returns the first packet and the affected packet, then refuses with Truncated.
open_policies.reference_rule: Returns the first packet, then reports the end of the stream without the affected packet.
open_policies.compat: none: no compat item reproduces the reference's rule

open_policies.policy: Triergon refuses two BlockMore elements with the same effective BlockAddID
open_policies.undecided: RFC 9559 section 5.1.3.5.2.3: each BlockAddID MUST be unique among the BlockMore elements of a BlockAdditions element, and an omitted BlockAddID is 1.
open_policies.rule: Returns the first packet, then refuses the BlockAdditions that repeats BlockAddID 1 with Invalid.
open_policies.reference_rule: Keeps the last BlockMore (last) and attaches it, with the LCEVC data, to both laces.
open_policies.compat: none: no compat item reproduces the reference's rule

open_policies.policy: Triergon refuses a BlockAddID above the track maximum
open_policies.undecided: RFC 9559 section 5.1.4.1.16: MaxBlockAdditionID is the maximum BlockAddID of the track, default 0, where 0 means the track has no BlockAdditions; this file declares none and carries BlockMores with IDs 1, 2, 3 and 8.
open_policies.rule: Returns the first packet, then refuses the second with Invalid (BlockAddID exceeds track maximum).
open_policies.reference_rule: Returns every packet and exports only the last BlockMore (ID 8, eight) on the second.
open_policies.compat: none: no compat item reproduces the reference's rule
